notes:
# Waymark 0.5.4

- Automatic farming guidance now follows the closest eligible unfinished pet as your position changes, instead of saving the first suggestion as a chosen target. Your goal shortlist remains the eligible pool when unfinished goals exist.
- Explicit choices are saved separately. Click a goal name, Use as target in pet details, or Another to choose a pet. Auto returns to nearest-target selection. Completed or unavailable chosen pets fall back to an automatic suggestion.
- Existing automatically saved suggestions from 0.5.3 no longer act as pinned choices.
- Removed the redundant pet-card chevron that overlapped the goal icon. The full card remains clickable to open details.
